name: ChatGPT
bestFor: The most widely adopted general-purpose AI assistant, for every function that needs a capable default chatbot
description: OpenAI's general-purpose assistant for writing, research, analysis, coding, and image/voice tasks — the default choice for broad, cross-functional AI assistance across an enterprise.

freeTier.limits: Free plan with core chat access; usage limits apply

paidTier.notes: Go is $8/mo; Plus $20/mo; Pro $100–$200/mo. Business is $25/user/month, or $20/user/month billed annually (2-seat minimum). Enterprise is custom, per-user pricing negotiated per organization.

name: Claude
bestFor: A general-purpose AI assistant known for careful reasoning, long-context work, and enterprise-grade trust and safety
description: Anthropic's general-purpose assistant for chat, writing, research, and analysis (distinct from Claude Code, its coding-specific tool), used broadly across teams for everyday AI-assisted work.

freeTier.limits: Free plan with web, desktop, and mobile chat access

paidTier.notes: Pro is $20/mo ($17/mo annual). Max from $100/mo (5x usage) or $200/mo (20x). Team Standard $25/seat/mo ($20 annual), Team Premium $125/seat/mo ($100 annual). Enterprise is $20/seat/month billed annually (20-seat minimum) plus usage at API rates.

name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
bestFor: An AI assistant embedded directly into Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams for organizations already on Microsoft 365
description: Copilot layered across the Microsoft 365 apps enterprises already run on — drafting documents, summarizing email threads and meetings, and building spreadsheets and slides from a prompt.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; requires an underlying Microsoft 365 license

paidTier.notes: $30/user/month billed yearly, on top of a qualifying Microsoft 365 license. Copilot Business (for Microsoft 365 Business plans) is $21/user/month annual — discounted to $18 for the first year through Dec 31, 2026 — or $25.20 paid monthly. Copilot Chat is included at no extra cost with eligible plans; advanced agent experiences are billed by usage through Copilot Credits.

name: Glean
bestFor: Enterprise search and a company-wide knowledge assistant that connects every internal tool and document
description: An enterprise AI search and knowledge assistant that indexes and reasons across a company's connected apps (Slack, Drive, Confluence, Jira, and more) to answer questions with cited internal sources.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; demo-and-quote sales process

paidTier.notes: No published pricing. Community- and procurement-reported figures put per-user cost around $45–$75+/user/month for the base search license, plus roughly $15/user/month for advanced AI features, with a ~100-seat / ~$50K–$60K minimum annual contract — not official figures.

name: Gemini Enterprise
bestFor: A company-wide AI agent platform for organizations standardized on Google Workspace and Google Cloud
description: Google's enterprise AI platform combining Gemini chat, permission-aware enterprise search, Deep Research, and no-code agents that work across Workspace and connected business apps.

freeTier.limits: No persistent free tier; a free start/trial is offered

paidTier.notes: Five editions — Business (1–500 users), Standard, Plus, Pay-as-you-go, and Frontline (150+ users) — but Google doesn't publish per-seat prices in its edition docs. Widely reported list prices are around $21/seat/month for Business and $30+/seat/month for Standard on annual commitments, plus usage beyond quota — not official figures.
